facts.title: KALLA Bookcase - assembly
source_steps: Lay the two sides (A) flat on the floor.
Fix the 4 shelves (B) between the sides with 12 screws (D).
Slide the back panel (C) into the grooves.
Fix the back with the 4 remaining screws (D).
Fix the bookcase to the wall with the safety strap.
warnings: Tall furniture can tip over and hurt children.
get_help: Missing a part? Call KALLA Helpline 0800 000 111.

steps.text_en: This guide shows how to build the KALLA bookcase.
steps.picture_prompt: A finished wooden bookcase with 4 shelves standing against a plain wall in a living room

steps.text_en: Lay the 2 sides (A) flat on the floor.
steps.picture_prompt: Two tall wooden side panels lying flat and parallel on a floor

steps.text_en: Fix the 4 shelves (B) between the sides with 12 screws (D). Tighten by hand.
steps.picture_prompt: A hand turning a screw to fix a wooden shelf between two side panels lying on the floor

steps.text_en: Two people stand the bookcase up.
steps.picture_prompt: Two adults lifting a bookcase frame upright together

steps.text_en: Slide the back panel (C) into the grooves.
steps.picture_prompt: A thin flat back panel being slid into grooves on the back of a bookcase

steps.text_en: Fix the back with the 4 remaining screws (D).
steps.picture_prompt: A hand screwing a screw into the back panel of a bookcase, 4 screws nearby

steps.text_en: Fix the bookcase to the wall with the safety strap.
steps.picture_prompt: A safety strap joining the top of a bookcase to a wall

steps.text_en: Tall furniture can tip over and hurt children.
steps.picture_prompt: A tall bookcase tipping forward towards a small child, with a red warning triangle

steps.text_en: Missing a part? Call KALLA Helpline 0800 000 111.
steps.picture_prompt: A person holding a telephone to their ear next to an open flat-pack box

steps.text_en: If something breaks or feels unsafe, stop and ask for help.
steps.picture_prompt: a person on the phone talking to a helper
